name: Abomos the Soultrapper

facts.text: Level 68, 30,000 health, slashing blows and a Lifedrain. At 50% health he calls two Abomos Servants (up to three alive).
Tur Suil holds spectral Sylvan and tortured Sylvan spirits.

story:
When the Sylvan first understood what was being raised on the crag above the burned valley, they went to burn it down. Most of them died on the stair. Abomos caught what was left. He is a trapper of souls, Balor's gaoler for the things that cannot be chained, and the spirits of the Sylvan raiders hang in his cells still, spectral and tortured, crying in voices too faint to make out. He feeds on them, and on whoever comes to free them, drinking life through the air. When he is hard pressed he calls his servants, made from the last of what he has eaten.

When the Sylvan understood what was rising on the crag above the burned valley, they sent their bravest to burn it down. Most of them died on the stair. Abomos caught what was left of them. He is a trapper of souls, Balor's gaoler for the things that cannot be chained, and he keeps them in cells along the tower's lower halls, spectral and tortured, where they cry in voices too faint to make out.

He feeds on them. He feeds on whoever comes to free them too, drinking life through the air from whoever stands before him, and the stronger his prey the longer he lingers over the meal. When he is hard pressed, at the half, he opens two of the cells and calls out his servants, made from the last of what he has eaten, never more than three at a time. He cannot be harmed outside his own halls. The Sylvan say that every spirit freed from his cells goes home to Domnann on the wind, and that on the nights after a raid kills him the forests there are full of whispers.
legend: He drains life, so keep heals rolling on whoever he targets. At half health two servants join: tanks pick them up, AoE or kill them, then finish him. Free the Sylvan spirits, the old hibs say, and the Vale grows a little greener. His lifedrain is steady, not sudden: the healers on his target keep it topped and the rest kill. At half, two servants come; tanks pick them up and AoE helps. Clear the spectral Sylvan in his halls before the pull. Superstition: Sylvan raiders whisper the names of their dead into his cells before the pull, so the spirits know help has come. The rest of the raid waits for them to finish.

loremasterTopic.text: Balor's soul-trapper. He keeps the spirits of the Sylvan who tried to burn Tur Suil, and feeds on them, and on whoever comes to free them.

bookPage: Muirgen writes: I was in Domnann the night after the realm's raid killed the soul-trapper, and I will set down only what I heard. The forest whispered. Not the wind; there was no wind. It whispered in a hundred voices, faint and glad, and the Sylvan came out of their houses and stood under the trees with their faces turned up, and some of them called names into the dark, and some of the names were answered. In the morning they said the dead had come home, the ones who went to burn the tower. They thanked the realm for it. I have never been thanked for anything so gravely.
